title: The Faithful Typewriter
author: Rosalind Ashgrove
blurb: Juniper Voss, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
